definitions.explanation: An argument or quarrel between a married couple. Combines {夫婦|ふうふ} (married couple) + {喧嘩|けんか} (quarrel).

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}{夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: We ended up having a marital quarrel last night.

examples.japanese: {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|く}わない→食う：02657_kuu⟧。
examples.english: Even a dog won't touch a married couple's quarrel. (proverb)

examples.japanese: ささいなこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}になった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{翌朝|よくあさ}→翌朝：03182_yokuasa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲直|なかなお}りした→仲直りする：06307_nakanaorisuru⟧。
examples.english: We got into a marital fight over something trivial, but made up the next morning.

notes:
Combines ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧ (married couple) + ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧; the け becomes げ by rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a marital quarrel
- {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧: marital fights never stop

CULTURAL NOTE:
The proverb {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|く}わない→食う：02657_kuu⟧ ('not even a dog will touch a married couple's quarrel') means outsiders should not meddle, since couples soon make up.
